ValidationRule.description: Can't update status to On Hold when previously on Case ready to review
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Cloud_uAssist_Order", NOT($Permission.Bypass_uAssist_Status_Validation),
OR( TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - Rx Form needs review', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - New photos needed', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - New scans needed', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - New X-Rays needed', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - New scans, photographs and X-Rays needed', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - Scans and images do not match', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - New photos and Rx form review needed', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'On Hold - Please review uAssist Message', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'Cancel', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'Rejected', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'Model Prep Complete', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'Model Prep in Progress', TEXT(uAssist_Status__c) == 'Tech Review' ),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(uAssist_Status__c), 'Case ready to review'), NOT(ISNULL(Billing_System_Inv_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Billing_System_Inv_Number__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can't update uAssist Status from Case ready to review - pls contact your manager.
